resources.string: Set daily limits for selected apps and earn extra time by exercising.
You can edit the defaults: 30 free minutes per app each day, a 60-minute shared daily limit, up to 20 reward minutes per app each day, and 5-minute sessions.
ScrollFit checks only the foreground app’s name for usage tracking. Exercise images are processed on your phone; no photos or videos are saved or sent.
Monitoring starts only when you enable it. Android Usage Access and Accessibility access must remain enabled; monitoring may miss app use if access is removed or the service stops.
Four exercise challenges and time rewards are ready for testing. Camera and monitoring behavior on a phone remains unverified.
